modules.title: 同一份内容在 1440px 和 390px 怎样重排
响应式设计怎样保留任务

items.title: 先看空间和操作方式
items.text: 窄屏不只是更小：文字行长、触控目标、侧边栏和表格都可能需要重排，优先保留用户完成当前任务所需的信息和操作。

items.title: 用规则切换布局
items.text: 断点是在某个条件下切换规则的阈值，媒体查询是 CSS 表达这些条件的方式。例如把下面规则粘贴到项目 CSS：`@media (max-width: 720px) { .cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }`。

items.title: 用浏览器模拟手机查看效果
items.text: 不需要真手机也能检查移动端布局。在 Chrome 开发者工具中，按 Cmd+Shift+M (Mac) 或 Ctrl+Shift+M (Windows) 即可切换设备模拟。你可以选择 iPhone 14 或 Samsung Galaxy 等常见手机尺寸。这是布局调整后最重要的验证步骤——在告诉 AI 你满意之前，一定要同时检查桌面端和移动端的效果。另外，Tailwind CSS 使用 sm:、md:、lg: 等响应式前缀来在不同屏幕宽度应用样式，所以当 AI 写出 md:grid-cols-3 时，它的意思是“在中等屏幕及以上使用 3 列”。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 响应式设计不等于媒体查询，也不等于只为手机做一份独立页面。媒体查询是常见技术手段；响应式的判断标准是不同空间下内容和操作是否仍可用。

lessonPractice.title: 三列商品卡放到手机上以后，文字和按钮都挤在一起。应该先怎样调整？

options.label: 改成单列或更少列，再检查文字和按钮是否容易使用
options.feedback: 对。响应式先保证当前任务能完成，再决定是否保留所有桌面排列。

options.label: 把桌面页面整体缩小，继续保留三列
options.feedback: 比例缩小会使文字和触控目标难用，不能保证手机上的任务可完成。

options.label: 保持三列宽度，改成横向滑动，让用户左右拖动浏览商品
options.feedback: 横向滑动会隐藏后面的商品，也增加逐项比较成本。常规商品列表应先减少列数，保证内容和购买操作可见。

en.title: Three desktop product-card columns make text cramped and buttons too small at 390px. What change should be proposed first?

options.label: Use one or fewer columns at mobile width and check that title, price, and button remain readable and tappable
options.feedback: Correct. Responsive work preserves the ability to complete the current task before preserving every desktop arrangement.

options.label: Scale down the entire desktop page proportionally; three columns must stay unchanged
options.feedback: Scaling makes text and touch targets unusable and does not ensure a mobile task can be completed.

options.label: Hide the title and purchase button, leaving only images to avoid crowding
options.feedback: That removes information and actions needed to buy rather than reorganizing the layout.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请在项目 CSS 中为卡片区加入 `@media (max-width: 720px)`：手机改为单列，桌面保持现有三列。改完后检查 390px 和 1440px，确认标题、价格、按钮和长文本都没有挤压或横向溢出。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: In the project CSS, add `@media (max-width: 720px)` for the card area: use one column on mobile while keeping the existing three columns on desktop. Check 390px and 1440px afterward and confirm titles, prices, buttons, and long text are not cramped or horizontally overflowing.

learning.assumes: You have opened the same site on a phone and a computer.
learning.outcome: You can state a layout goal at a specific screen width and verify reading, tapping, and overflow at both desktop and mobile widths.

modules.title: How the same content reflows at 1440px and 390px
How responsive design preserves a task

items.title: Start with space and interaction
items.text: A narrow screen is not merely smaller: line length, touch targets, sidebars, and tables may need reflow. Keep the information and actions required for the current task first.

items.title: Rules switch the layout
items.text: A breakpoint is a threshold for switching rules, and a media query is CSS syntax for expressing the condition. For example, paste this into project CSS: `@media (max-width: 720px) { .cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }`.

items.title: Use browser to simulate mobile views
items.text: You don't need a real phone to check mobile layout. In Chrome DevTools, press Cmd+Shift+M (Mac) or Ctrl+Shift+M (Windows) to toggle device simulation. You can select common phone sizes like iPhone 14 or Samsung Galaxy. This is the most important verification step after any layout change - always check both desktop and mobile views before telling the AI you're satisfied. Additionally, Tailwind CSS uses responsive prefixes like sm:, md:, lg: to apply styles at different screen widths, so when AI writes md:grid-cols-3, it means 'use 3 columns from medium screens and up'.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Responsive design is neither identical to media queries nor a separate page only for phones. Media queries are one common tool; the test for responsiveness is whether content and actions remain usable in different spaces.
